title: PSA Build custom tools!
author: Kindly_Access7577
selftext:
Building tools vs building your app/game has tended to be bad advice for anything that wasnt critical to your workflow: time spent and maintenance costs would be too high.

Nowadays though agents are so capable is you should genuinely consider spinning up an agent to build custom tooling for anything- even open source software.

Here I wanted some subset of Blender functionality plus some tweaks and to have it work in VR. In just a few hours Claude built this : supports obj/edit mode, vert/edge/face editing, functions like loop cuts, extrudes, modifiers like mirror, subdiv, hull, general functionality undo/redo/load/save, bones, autorig, posing, the works. And all of this tweakable in the ways I want for my needs. 

Just a PSA to think bigger on tools!

comments.author: FragmentedHeap
comments.body:
Yep, been saying the same thing... I'm working on this (this is a demo of the pieces I've built so far.)

https://i.redd.it/ho13o63h3j0i1.png

Build a whole engine from scratch in rust...

\* MTSDF Text Rendering Engine (renders multi channel signed distance field fonts instead of normal font techniques)  
\* Sound Engine called "Resound"  
\* Full Image Format support, including professional formats, tiff, hdr and on and on.  
\* Layout Engine -> Origami... It uses a css engine (selectors work the same way and it's build on taffys system and designed to be able to reproduce html like layouts, but no browser.)  
\* Lighting, and on and on

The whole thing is built on top of native web gpu.

Right now I'm working on the element pack for origami, and my plan is to make my own verison of html/css work with the engine so I can actually port tailwind to work on this system.

Then I'm going to build "3DA" 3d agent, which is similar to the tool you have hear, except I'm not doing to use my hands to manipulate the UI.

There will be a slew of agents in the app and voice AI and I'll talk to it, and I will only use my hands when I need to tweak stuff.

Edit: Forgot to mention it's got a whole text editing engine that can handle 1TB text files and is full utf8 and unicode 18 out of the box.

replies.author: FragmentedHeap
replies.body:
https://i.redd.it/q9zv5ueg4j0i1.png

It's a Rust/CSharp hybrid.

I'm building all the modular components in rust, but they all get build to capi dlls, and then there's csharp bindings for everything and it's all aot compatible and statically linkable.

I'm basically in the "I'm going to rebuild everything from the ground up" phase...

It's cross platform Linux/Mac/Windows out of the box, also Windows ARM.  And I'm planning on pulling in Android/IOS too.

The fonts in mtsdf are heavy though, so ram usuage is higher than I would like, but mtsdf text rendering solves 3d text problems, and text looks amazing in 3d so I'm trying to optimize it.

This demo eats about 540 mb.

Also thats with a font thats full unicode 18, with emoticons/emojis.  It's MUCH MUCH lighter if you only build ASCII.
